text: 证监会发布行政处罚决定书显示，证监会对陈广华（男）编造、传播虚假信息行为进行了立案调查。经查明，当事人存在以下违法事实：一、陈广华传播虚假信息，陈广华使用本人实名认证的某自媒体账号，粉丝数量超103万人(某自媒体认证：投资达人、财经博主)，具有一定互联网传播影响力。陈广华于2026年2月3日使用上述自媒体账号发布含有税率调整内容的信息。经查，上述信息为虚假信息。
text_en: The CSRC's administrative penalty decision shows that the CSRC opened an investigation into Chen Guanghua (male) for fabricating and disseminating false information. Upon investigation, the following illegal facts were established: 1. Chen Guanghua disseminated false information. Chen Guanghua used a self-media account verified under his own real name, with more than 1.03 million followers (self-media certification: investment expert, financial blogger), giving him a certain influence in internet dissemination. On February 3, 2026, Chen Guanghua used the above self-media account to publish information containing tax rate adjustment content. Upon investigation, the above information was false.
